The '''Central District''' was a district in [[New Adasta]], the capital city of [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. In [[3636 BBY]] the former Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] came to the world and possessed many of the Imperials on the planet, turning them into his puppets to murder civilians and the Central District become a point of intense conflict before Vitiate wiped out all life on the planet.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Central District was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in game update 3.2.<ref name="SWTOR" />
